review_order: First read the local authored mathematical source only and independently reconstruct its statement, proof/construction topology and boundaries before inspecting implementation Lean
Then inspect all public formal declarations, relevant imports and decoder reconstruction; compare them with the source and check its mathematical proof
Record your own verdict and semantic-slot comparisons; do not read publication-candidate assumptions/classifications, original author verdicts or earlier task summaries
review_questions: Does the full source exactly match each public statement, including empty/zero/deficient/tall cases?
Does the mathematical argument justify the claims without hidden independence or nonzero assumptions?
Are all in-scope proof steps and genuine formal prerequisites exposed, with no existence-to-algorithm inference?
Are any quantum conventions or resource claims asserted beyond the formal contract?
Is there source or implementation drift, unsupported novelty, unproved correction, or duplicated mathematics?
boundary: This is a local mathematical-contract audit, not external-paper assimilation or validation of the entire migration/main deployment. Whole-module source/semantic evidence must stay separate from integration/reader/purification gates.
